name: read_file
description: Read a text file in the workspace. Returns the full contents and the content version. Use start_line and end_line for files longer than 400 lines.

name: list_directory
description: List files and subdirectories of a workspace directory, with sizes. Hidden files are omitted unless include_hidden is true.

name: search_text
description: Search workspace files for a regular expression. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers, at most max_results matches.

name: replace_text
description: Replace one exact occurrence of text in a workspace file. Fails if the old text occurs zero times or more than once. Returns the file versions before and after.

name: write_file
description: Create a new workspace file or overwrite an existing one with the given contents. Prefer replace_text for small edits to existing files.

name: run_tests
description: Run the selected Python test files in a fresh process. Returns counts, failing test names and assertion messages.

name: run_suite
description: Run a set of test modules verbosely and return the full log, with paths relative to the workspace.

name: run_command
description: Run a shell command in the workspace sandbox with a timeout in seconds. Network access is disabled. Returns exit code, stdout and stderr, each truncated to 20,000 characters.

name: git_status
description: Show the working tree status of the workspace repository: staged, unstaged and untracked files.

name: git_diff
description: Show the diff of the working tree or of a commit range. Use paths to limit the diff to specific files.

name: git_log
description: Show recent commits with author, date and subject, newest first.

name: git_commit
description: Commit staged changes with the given message. Requires approval if the branch is protected.

name: open_pull_request
description: Open a pull request from the current branch. Requires approval. Returns the pull request URL.

name: read_issue
description: Read an issue from the tracker by its number, including comments and labels.

name: comment_on_issue
description: Add a comment to an issue in the tracker. The comment is posted under the user's identity.

name: search_docs
description: Search the team's engineering documentation and return the best passages with document ids and revision dates.

name: fetch_url
description: Fetch a web page from an allowlisted domain and return its text content, truncated to 30,000 characters.

name: query_metrics
description: Run a read-only query against the metrics store for the last N hours and return a table of results.

name: read_record
description: Read lines from a record of this run's execution record by record id, for example a full test log that the context shows only as a digest.

name: remember
description: Store a short note in the user's long-term memory with a scope and an expiry date. Do not store secrets.

name: recall
description: Search the user's long-term memory for notes relevant to the query, returning notes with their scope and dates.

name: ask_user
description: Ask the user a question and wait for the answer. Use only when a decision needs the user.

name: delegate
description: Start a worker agent on a bounded subtask with its own context. Returns the worker's result record id.

name: deploy
description: Deploy the current build to the named environment. Requires approval and an explicit environment.
